people.name: Judea
people.line: The southern region of Israel, centered around Jerusalem

translations.web: Now the apostles and the brothers who were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.
translations.bsb: The apostles and brothers throughout Judea soon heard that the Gentiles also had received the word of God.
